$description: Material 3 Expressive design tokens, parsed from the Jetpack Compose Material 3 token sources. 1 dp = 1 px at density 1; sp likewise before font scaling.

ref.$description: Reference tokens: the raw palette and typefaces. Components never use these directly.

sys.$description: System tokens: the roles components are built from. Colour and springs carry a second mode in $extensions.

color.$description: Colour roles. $value is the light scheme; $extensions.m3e.modes.dark the dark one.

spring.$description: Spring physics: damping ratio and stiffness (N/m, unit mass). $value is the Expressive motion scheme; $extensions.m3e.modes.standard the Standard one.

corner.$description: Corner shapes. A 50% radius means half the component's shorter side (a pill or circle).

typescale.$description: Type scale properties. Sizes, line heights and tracking are in sp, written as px.

typography.$description: Composite text styles built from sys.typescale.

comp.$description: Component tokens, one group per component variant, aliasing sys tokens.
